title: Production Operator
description:
Join to apply for the Production Operator role at Piramal Pharma Ltd

Position will be responsible for control and monitoring of the manufacturing systems at the Bethlehem site to synthesize and purify inhalation anesthetic agents.

Job Overview

Responsible for controlling and monitoring manufacturing systems at the Bethlehem site, focusing on synthesizing and purifying inhalation anesthetic agents.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Follow operating procedures and safety rules; understand all relevant procedures.
  2. Participate in 5S and SFTI initiatives in manufacturing.
  3. Assist in troubleshooting automation and operational issues.
  4. Enter SAP data in real-time for all production processes.
  5. Coordinate work with Maintenance and submit work orders.
  6. Report alarms and take appropriate actions.
  7. Achieve manufacturing schedules and production goals.
  8. Complete accurate manufacturing batch records using electronic and manual data.
  9. Maintain audit-ready manufacturing areas with up-to-date documentation.
  10. Ensure a safe and healthy working environment in cooperation with management and colleagues.
  11. Report all incidents and accidents promptly.
  12. Adhere to cGMP (21 CFR 210 & 211) standards.
  13. Operate reactors, distillation columns, filters, and molecular sieves.
  14. Read meters and gauges to verify operating conditions.
  15. Operate and control electric motors, pumps, and valves.
  16. Handle hazardous chemicals safely.
  17. Adjust controls and override automatic systems as needed.
  18. Take samples for Quality Control analysis.
  19. Adjust pH levels of discharged water.
  20. Inspect equipment regularly for malfunctions.
  21. Record operations and maintenance actions.
  22. Maintain cleanliness and organization in the workplace.
  23. Operate forklifts and pallet jacks.
  24. Assist other departments as needed.
  25. Perform additional duties as assigned by the Shift Supervisor.

Key Competencies

  • High school diploma or GED; 1-2 years related experience or equivalent.
  • Ability to interpret safety rules, instructions, and manuals.
  • Basic math skills and ability to interpret data.
  • Ability to understand and carry out instructions; problem-solving skills.
  • Physical ability to perform job duties, including lifting up to 50 pounds and wearing PPE.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

Education / Experience

High school diploma or equivalent; technical skills recommended but not mandatory. Experience with SAP or similar systems is preferred.

Work Environment

Moderately undesirable conditions with exposure to temperature variations, chemicals, noise, and potential minor injuries.

Supervision

Works under moderate to limited supervision, following objectives set by management, with some independence in handling situations.

EEO Statement

Piramal Pharma Ltd is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

Informações da Vaga

Descrição

Prestar assistência farmacêutica; esclarecer possíveis dúvidas sobre a posologia e formas distintas de administração de medicamentos, de acordo com a necessidade ou solicitações de clientes, mediante leitura, pesquisas junto aos fabricantes, órgãos públicos e privados especializados; atender os clientes de forma humanizada, para a dispensação de medicamentos aos pacientes, ler e interpretar os receituários médicos, buscar o produto, orientar o cliente quanto ao seu uso e aplicação (posologia, cuidados, possíveis efeitos colaterais, etc.) e processar a venda, visando a satisfação do cliente e a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade definidos pela empresa para o atendimento ao público.

Responsabilizar-se pelo processo de identificação de usuários de medicamentos controlados, de acordo com a legislação; orientar e supervisionar os demais colaboradores da sua loja, quanto à atuação na dispensação de medicamentos, sempre que necessário; acompanhar e manter o controle sobre os prazos de validade dos medicamentos, realizando a segregação e o envio de medicamentos para o destino correto; conferir e controlar os estoques de medicamentos, sendo responsável direto pelos estoques dos medicamentos controlados e antibióticos, mantendo o armário de psicotrópicos chaveado e com placa de identificação.

Manter-se atento à precificação dos produtos expostos e seus prazos de validade; responsabilizar-se pela condição de armazenamento dos produtos e sua reposição, bem como zelar pela correta precificação dos itens e estreita observação dos prazos de validade fixados nas embalagens; realizar relatório diário da movimentação dos medicamentos controlados e antibióticos, anexando as receitas das respectivas vendas; realizar balanços (mensais, trimestrais e anuais) das listas obrigatórias da Portaria 344/98; realizar semanalmente a auditoria de estoque dos medicamentos controlados, por meio de sistema informatizado da empresa, mantendo o armário com estoque correto.

Limpar e organizar o armário dos medicamentos controlados, cuidando o prazo de validade dos mesmos, com intuito de não perder nenhum prazo de validade; orientar os demais colaboradores sobre o correto preenchimento e uso do carimbo de receituários específicos, e quanto ao preenchimento no computador, onde os dados devem ser fiéis às receitas, com todos os campos corretamente preenchidos; promover treinamentos de vendas, mediante controle, supervisão e acompanhamento nos programas Farmácia Popular, dispensação de psicotrópicos, obedecendo às normas, legislações vigentes e negociações realizadas com órgãos públicos.

Arquivar e responsabilizar-se pela autorização de funcionamento concedida pela Vigilância Sanitária para o sistema informatizado de venda de medicamentos controlados (SNGPC); manter atualizado, arquivado e válido o Alvará Sanitário (ou protocolo-SUS), Autorização de Funcionamento (Anivsa), Licença de Funcionamento (Prefeitura), Certidão de Regularidade (CRF), Alvará dos Bombeiros, Certificado de Dedetização e demais documentos obrigatórios; manter a placa de identificação da farmácia atualizada, contendo: Nome fantasia, razão social, endereço, n de registro no CRF, CNPJ, inscrição estadual, nome dos farmacêuticos titular e substitutos com n de registro junto ao CRF e respectivos horários de funcionamento da loja e telefones do CRF, Vigilância Sanitária Estadual e Municipal e PROCON.

Manter atualizado o Manual de Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, POP’s e Plano de Gerenciamento de Resíduos (PGRSS) e os aplicar de acordo com orientação; possuir arquivada a cópia do contrato de prestação de serviço com a empresa de coleta de resíduos e da licença de operação e transporte da mesma, junto a Fepan; manter cadastro atualizado anualmente de todos os fornecedores de medicamentos, com autorização de Funcionamento da Anvisa, Alvará Sanitário, Alvará de Localização e Funcionamento, CNPJ, CRF, publicação no DOU (Diário Oficial da União) e autorização especial, quando houver; manter o registro de treinamentos aplicados à sua equipe.

Emitir relatórios e preencher planilhas diversas para atender à legislação quanto ao controle de medicamentos especiais ou relatar a devolução de medicamentos por prazo vencido; atender a fiscalização de órgãos públicos (CRF, Vigilância Sanitária e outros) providenciando a documentação requerida ou proceder aos ajustes necessários apontados pelos Auditores; manter o guia da farmácia digital atualizado nos computadores, para fins de consulta de clientes e colaboradores; reter a receita na venda de medicamentos; recepcionar os clientes, aviar receitas, fornecer orientações necessárias ao cliente sobre o medicamento; manter o setor organizado, supervisionando a higienização do ambiente.

Manter-se atualizado sobre as características dos medicamentos novos, conforme divulgações dos laboratórios ou informações contidas nas bulas, utilizando tais conhecimentos para o benefício dos clientes e repassando-os aos colegas; auxiliar na reposição das mercadorias e conhecer a disposição e organização dos produtos na loja; efetuar troca de mercadorias para clientes, com autorização do superior, cumprindo políticas específicas; participar das reuniões, cursos e treinamentos para conhecimento de alterações ou novas políticas adotadas; auxiliar no levantamento do estoque físico para fins de balanço, quando solicitado; nas filiais que dispõem de Salas de Serviços Farmacêuticos, realizar atendimento aos pacientes, conforme serviços disponibilizados; garantir o funcionamento do sistema SGNPC, por meio da verificação e envio de relatórios, além do monitoramento de possíveis intercorrências; garantir o controle de temperatura de ambiente e de geladeiras, mediante apresentação de planilhas de monitoramento; cumprir e exigir que processos da loja sejam realizados obedecendo às normas e legislações vigentes.

title: Systeemtherapeut
description:
Werken bij Stichting JA! – Dichtbij, Outreachend en Betekenisvol

Bij Stichting JA! staan we midden tussen de inwoners in de wijk. We bieden aanvullende gespecialiseerde jeugdhulp in Amsterdam, Diemen, Uithoorn en Ouder-Amstel, zonder onnodige drempels. Onze aanpak? Outreachend, laagdrempelig en dichtbij, bij gezinnen thuis, op scholen en op alle plekken waar jeugdigen zich bevinden.

In onze multidisciplinaire gebiedsteams bundelen we de krachten met professionals uit verschillende organisaties. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat gezinnen snel en effectief de juiste ondersteuning krijgen. Geen hulpvraag is hetzelfde, en dát maakt ons werk dynamisch, uitdagend en ontzettend waardevol.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je wordt onderdeel van een gedreven gebiedsteams in de regio {VUL IN}

Samen met psychiaters, (GZ-)psychologen, orthopedagogen(-generalisten), systeemtherapeuten, jeugd- en gezinscoaches en IAG-ers werk je aan complexe hulpvragen. We kijken juist niet alleen naar problemen, maar vooral naar de kracht en veerkracht van elk gezin.

Waarom kiezen voor Stichting JA!?

  • Dichtbij en betrokken: Je bent aanwezig in de wijk en staat letterlijk naast gezinnen.
  • Systemisch werken: Alleen door systemisch te werken, komen we samen tot duurzame oplossingen.
  • Maatwerk : Geen standaardoplossingen, maar hulp die écht past.
  • Sterk netwerk: Samenwerken met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines.
  • Ruimte om te groeien : Je leert van de specialisten om je heen én krijgt de vrijheid om je te ontwikkelen in de richting die bij jou past

Wil jij bijdragen aan een veerkrachtige jeugd in Amsterdam en omstreken? Sluit je aan bij ons team!

Als Systeemtherapeut bij Stichting JA! werk je met gezinnen die te maken hebben met complexe problematiek. Je staat midden in de leefwereld van gezinnen en bent daar waar het écht nodig is: thuis bij gezinnen, op school of in de wijk.

Je kijkt niet alleen naar het individu, maar naar het hele gezinssysteem en de bredere context. Samen met het gezin onderzoek je vastgelopen patronen en help je bij het herstellen van verbindingen en het versterken van veerkracht. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s in het gebiedsteam en draagt bij aan een warme, systemische aanpak waarin de cliënt centraal staat.

Waar kom je in dienst?

Iedereen die werkzaam is bij Stichting JA! is in dienst van een van onze moederorganisaties. Onze moederorganisaties zijn: FamilySupporters, Groei & Glunder, Timon, Terminal 18, Zigzag Kindzorg, Fibbe.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste, positieve collega en je omarmt onze manier van werken;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met het werken met gezinnen die kampen met complexe problematiek en bent in staat ‘out-of-the-box’ oplossingen voor hen te creëren;
  • Je wordt enthousiast van outreachend werken, waarbij je midden tussen de gezinnen in de wijk staat;
  • Je bent een verbindende persoonlijkheid die in staat is integraal samen te werken; zowel met het systeem van het gezin, als met andere betrokken partijen, zoals het ouder- kindteam, buurtteam en jeugdhulpverleners van andere jeugdhulporganisaties;
  • Je vindt het leuk om jouw kennis over te dragen aan collega’s om met elkaar verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Je durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en bent initiatiefnemend;
  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot Systeemtherapeut;
  • Je bent in het bezit van een NVRG-registratie
  • Je bent in het bezit van een SKJ-registratie

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een gedreven, multidisciplinair team waar collegialiteit, overleg en van elkaar leren (casuïstiek, intervisie en werkbegeleiding) centraal staan.
  • Ruimte om zelf te blijven groeien als professional, door ervaring en door de opleidingsmogelijkheden die we bieden.
  • JA! organiseert vier keer per jaar inhoudelijke kennissessies met gastsprekers om de kwaliteit en inhoud van ons werk verder te versterken.
  • Een team waarin iedereen zich welkom en gezien voelt, ongeacht culturele achtergrond, religie of levensstijl.
  • De ruimte om jouw werkweek in te vullen op een manier die voor jou werkt;
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris en 8% vakantietoeslag;
  • Reiskosten vergoeding of een NS-businesskaart;
  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;
  • De ruimte om samen met bevlogen collega’s JA! verder te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan de toekomst van de jeugdhulp in Amsterdam.

Enthousiast geraakt?

Ben jij een Systeemtherapeut en word jij net zo enthousiast over de kansen en mogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie als wij dat zijn? Dan praten we graag verder! Stuur jouw CV naar of neem contact op voor een (verkennend) gesprek via of 06-40239002.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presentes em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore, e buscamos ser um hub integrado de saúde, com iniciativas como o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico para acompanhamento individualizado.

description:
Quem somos e porque estamos contratando.

Fundada em 2016, somos o braço especializado na oferta de serviços terceirizados de profissionais de TI, permitindo que nossos clientes mantenham foco em seus propósitos de negócios e confiem a TI com a gente.

Em linha com o crescimento da demanda por esses serviços, reestruturamos nossa organização trazendo grandes talentos e especialistas para comporem nosso time.

Nossos colaboradores são nosso maior e melhor ativo, por isso buscamos profissionais dinâmicos, apaixonados por TI, inovação e qualidade, que coloquem o cliente em primeiro lugar, mas que também priorizem o seu bem-estar e de todo grupo, valorizando a importância do contínuo aprendizado.

Descrição das atividades:

Levantamento de Requisitos:

  • Conduzir entrevistas e workshops com stakeholders (juízes, servidores da justiça, advogados) para entender os processos de negócio existentes e necessidades propostas.
  • Documentar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais de forma clara, precisa e detalhada para interpretação e produção eficazes.
  • Utilizar técnicas de exploração de requisitos como análise de documentos, observação direta e prototipagem.
  • Mapear e modelar os processos de negócio utilizando notações BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation).
  • Identificar gargalos, ineficiências e oportunidades de automação nos processos existentes para melhorias no modelo de negócio do cliente.
  • Elaborar especificações detalhadas de requisitos, incluindo casos de uso, histórias de usuário e diagramas de fluxo.
  • Garantir compreensão mútua das especificações por stakeholders do negócio e equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de modelagem e documentação de requisitos (ex: Jira, Confluence).
  • Participar da validação das soluções desenvolvidas, assegurando atendimento aos requisitos.
  • Apoiar testes funcionais e de aceitação para verificar conformidade.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre cliente e equipe de desenvolvimento, facilitando comunicação e alinhamento.
  • Colaborar na resolução de problemas e melhorias, antecipando desvios.
  • Apoiar elaboração de manuais de usuário e materiais de treinamento.
  • Monitorar adoção das soluções e identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Conhecimento do Negócio Jurídico:
  • Compreensão dos processos e fluxos de tribunais de justiça, tribunais de contas, etc. (desejável)
  • Familiaridade com legislação e regulamentação do setor jurídico.
  • Conhecimento das necessidades e desafios dos profissionais do direito.
  • Conhecimento de BPM: conceitos e princípios de Business Process Management.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de modelagem e automação de processos (ex: Bizagi, Bonita, Camunda).
  • Familiaridade com notações BPMN.
  • Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados complexos.
  • Pensamento crítico e resolução de problemas eficaz.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders.
Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (ex: Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão de requisitos (ex: Jira, Confluence).
  • Noções de programação em Java e arquitetura de software (desejável).
Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada como Analista de Negócios/Funcional em automação de processos.
  • Experiência no setor jurídico ou projetos para tribunais (desejável).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BPM (ex: Bizagi, Bonita, Camunda).
Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Capacidade de alinhar soluções de automação com objetivos estratégicos do cliente.
  • Habilidade de identificar oportunidades de inovação e transformação digital no setor jurídico.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias emergentes como IA, blockchain e RPA.
  • Habilidade de liderar mudanças organizacionais.
  • Capacidade de engajar stakeholders na adoção de novas soluções.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pelo atendimento aos clientes e execução dos procedimentos operacionais padrão, visando promover uma experiência de compra positiva e garantir o cumprimento das legislações vigentes para farmácias, tanto na filial quanto na regional de atuação.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva aos clientes, atendendo às suas necessidades, oferecendo variedade de produtos e mantendo um ambiente limpo, organizado e acolhedor;
  2. Realizar a venda de medicamentos, verificando receita médica e/ou sob supervisão do farmacêutico, conforme procedimentos operacionais e legais para remédios controlados;
  3. Registrar produtos e medicamentos, conferindo as quantidades físicas com o registro no caixa, além de verificar o recebimento de valores e devolver o troco aos clientes quando necessário;
  4. Efetuar o fechamento do movimento de caixa e prevenir quebras de caixa;
  5. Contribuir para o atingimento de metas de vendas, realizando o abastecimento e a precificação nas áreas de exposição, de acordo com o layout da loja, garantindo a disposição de todo o mix de produtos para os clientes;
  6. Auxiliar na conferência, armazenagem e abastecimento de produtos recebidos, verificando quantidades físicas, validade, condições de embalagem e disposição adequada;
  7. Contribuir para a qualidade e conservação de medicamentos e produtos, zelando pela prevenção de perdas e riscos, cumprindo os padrões do Manual de Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, realizando balanços rotativos, inventários, descarte correto de produtos e controle de validade;
  8. Preservar e manter em bom estado os ativos da loja, solicitando manutenção e monitorando o funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Benefícios

  • Insalubridade
  • Refeição no local
  • Plano de carreira
  • Assistência social
  • Plano de saúde
  • Seguro de vida

Sobre o Grupo Pereira

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem como propósito "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor".

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e Distrito Federal, o grupo possui mais de 125 unidades de negócio, incluindo lojas do Comper, Fort Atacadista, Atacado Bate Forte, Broker, SempreFort, Pera Turismo e postos de combustíveis.

Além disso, oferece soluções logísticas com a Perlog e serviços financeiros com o Vuon, incluindo o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica.

O grupo visa oferecer uma experiência de compra positiva por meio de excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e colaboradores, contribuindo com a sociedade através de programas socioambientais.

title: Analista Financeiro
description:
Responsável por gerenciar, monitorar e analisar dados financeiros da empresa para garantir o controle eficaz dos recursos, apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas e promover a sustentabilidade financeira do negócio. Atua em diversas frentes, como planejamento orçamentário, análise de investimentos, gestão de fluxo de caixa e controle de custos.

Atividades que desempenhará:

  • Orçamento
    • Controlar o desempenho financeiro em relação ao orçamento aprovado.
    • Identificar desvios e propor soluções corretivas.
  • Fluxo de Caixa
    • Controlar e projetar o fluxo de caixa da empresa.
    • Identificar necessidades de liquidez ou excedentes para aplicação financeira.
    • Assegurar o cumprimento de compromissos financeiros.
  • Indicadores Financeiros
    • Analisar KPIs financeiros, como margem de lucro, liquidez, endividamento e ROI.
    • Elaborar relatórios com insights financeiros e tendências de desempenho.
    • Apresentar os indicadores à CFO e propor melhorias.
  • Contas a Pagar e Receber
    • Monitorar vencimentos e realizar previsões de pagamentos e recebimentos.
    • Negociar prazos e condições de pagamento com fornecedores e clientes.
    • Garantir a eficiência nos processos de cobrança e pagamento.
  • Faturamento
    • Emissão de Notas Fiscais: Emitir notas de produtos/serviços com informações corretas e classificação tributária adequada.
    • Controle de Documentos Fiscais: Organizar, arquivar e conferir notas fiscais emitidas e recebidas.
    • Apuração de Impostos: Calcular tributos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e repassar dados fiscais à contabilidade.
    • Lançamentos no ERP: Registrar dados no sistema financeiro e integrar com contas a receber e estoque.
    • Gestão de Boletos e Cobrança: Gerar, enviar e acompanhar boletos bancários e inadimplências.
    • Conciliação Financeira: Verificar notas fiscais emitidas versus pagamentos recebidos e corrigir inconsistências.
    • Relatórios Gerenciais: Criar relatórios sobre vendas, receitas e tributos para suporte à gestão.
  • Conformidade e Auditoria
    • Assegurar que as práticas financeiras estejam em conformidade com regulamentações locais e internacionais (ex.: IFRS).
    • Atender as demandas das auditorias internas e externas.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios Gerenciais
    • Realizar os relatórios financeiros para subsidiar o controle de processos da área.
    • Alimentar os dashboards e painéis de controle para visualização de resultados financeiros.
    • Fornecer análises detalhadas para suporte à gestão.
  • Melhoria de Processos Financeiros
    • Revisar e otimizar processos financeiros para aumentar a eficiência.
    • Implementar ferramentas de automação e integração de sistemas.
    • Garantir a atualização e manutenção de sistemas ERP (ex.: SAP, TOTVS).

Requisitos para o Cargo

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças (desejável).

Experiência:

  • Experiência anterior em áreas financeiras, contábeis ou de controladoria.
  • Vivência em análise de investimentos e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Ferramentas financeiras: Excel avançado (VBA, Power Query), Power BI.
  • IMPRESCINDÍVEL TER ATUADO COM SAP

A mineradora é a indústria mais longeva do país, com 190 anos de atuação, e uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do Brasil. Na AngloGold Ashanti, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força transformadora. Como parte desse compromisso, atuamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de gênero no setor e avançar na construção de um futuro mais justo e sustentável.

title: Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security
description:
Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security

Company: Ball Corporation

Location: SÃO Jose Dos Campos, São Paulo, BR, 12246-876

Date: Feb 20, 2025

Job Category: IT Administration

Req. ID: 41189

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English .

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls, Web Content Filtering, Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System, SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management, Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Security Incident Management, Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, and security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments, and security.
  2. Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  3. Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  4. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  5. Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  6. Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  7. Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  8. Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers, and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  9. Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  10. Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  11. Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  12. Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.
  13. Create and modify procedural documentation as needed.
  14. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and frameworks, such as SOX, HIPAA, or NIST.
  15. Develop and maintain incident response plans, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience in the face of cybersecurity threats.
  16. Ensure that all information systems operate in accordance with set standards.
  17. Participate in an on-call rotation with the department.
  18. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Unit, and the Company.

Main Requirements/Knowledge

  1. Advanced Level of English.
  2. Experience in a cyber-security operations environment including 4+ years of technical leadership.
  3. CISSP, CISM, CISA certifications preferred; other security relevant certifications considered.
  4. Knowledge of CISCO ASA solutions specifically remote access.
  5. Technical “hands-on” proficiency with at least three security-related systems and applications.
  6. Technical proficiency with security-related systems and applications, especially mainstream OS’s.
  7. Experience in documenting and maintaining processes and procedures.
  8. Knowledge of information security principles, including risk assessment, intrusion detection, and network access control.
  9. Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, and associated network protocols and concepts.
  10. Knowledge of SANS Twenty Critical Controls information security policies, procedures, guidelines, and methodologies desired.
  11. A strong familiarity with cryptographic concepts and their practical application.
  12. Experience in securing Cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, SAP, etc.
  13. Knowledge and Understanding of the CI/CD Pipeline along with tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo.
  14. Experience in driving technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  15. Proven focus in metrics-driven delivery: defining Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring SLAs, and enhancing environment to meet SLAs.
  16. Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices.

title: Commodity Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Commodity Manager role at DRiV Incorporated

Work Arrangement: ON-SITE

Tenneco is one of the world’s leading designers, manufacturers, and marketers of automotive products for original equipment and aftermarket customers, with approximately 65,000 team members working at more than 200 sites worldwide. Through our four business groups, DRiV, Performance Solutions, Clean Air, and Powertrain, Tenneco is driving advancements in global mobility by delivering technology solutions for diversified global markets, including light vehicle, commercial truck, off-highway, industrial, motorsport, and the aftermarket.

Job Title: Commodity Manager

Work Arrangement: ON-SITE

This position will report within the DRiV business group, which is Tenneco’s aftermarket product solutions group. DRiV aims to deliver advancements that help people get the most out of every vehicle, ride, race, and journey. We focus on delivering top-tier results behind branded product solutions for our community and shareholders.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  1. Develop and implement commodity strategies to achieve corporate, purchasing, and business line goals/objectives.
  2. Organize and lead commodity strategy meetings with cross-functional and cross-business audiences across regions.
    • Work with DRiV operations to develop scope of work for services, equipment, etc., for RFPs with existing and potential suppliers.
  3. Support performance-based requirements regionally for assigned commodities, focusing on KPIs such as sourcing ratio, auction, savings %, working capital, and supplier rationalization.
    • Supply base rationalization, development, spend management, segmentation considering geographic factors, BCC, localization, and technology trends.
    • Proven experience in negotiation levers including e-RFP and e-auction.
    • Knowledge of supply market trends and characteristics.
    • Utilize commodity expertise to create/update Business Plans and Strategic Plan Metrics, including cost reduction and technology drivers.
    • Set negotiation strategies and lead negotiations.
    • Drive cash flow improvements through negotiations on payment terms, stock agreements, and inventory management.
  4. Organize and lead Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) for assigned commodities.
    • Develop supplier partnerships and strategic alliances.
    • Manage supplier approval processes and escalate relationship issues.
    • Manage risks related to supplier financial instability or insolvency.
    • Enforce Tenneco’s supplier requirements.
  5. Coordinate with legal teams to ensure contractual compliance and risk mitigation.
  6. Travel required: 5-25%, domestically and internationally.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Materials Management, or Logistics; MBA preferred. CPM/CPIM certification is a plus.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years in Purchasing, Procurement, or Materials Management.
  • Experience with RFQ processes, data analysis, and commodity strategies.
  • Proven high-level negotiation and materials management experience.

Skills

  • Experience leading a global team to achieve savings.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English.

Additional Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Purchasing and Supply Chain
  • Industry: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing

title: OPERADOR DE CALANDRA - EGSA
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A EGSA DO BRASIL é uma indústria de equipamentos para transporte, distribuição e armazenamento de produtos líquidos e gasosos, fornecendo soluções com excelência e inovação para as maiores empresas do Brasil e da América Latina. Somos especialistas em atender as necessidades de nossos clientes, na fabricação de Tanque Vaso de pressão, Tanque Inox e Projetos especiais que atendem as especificações e necessidades de nossos clientes. Com mais de 40 anos de experiência no mercado, e com know-how próprio, garantimos o máximo de qualidade e proporcionamos a maior capacidade de transporte, distribuição e armazenamento para nossos clientes, sempre atendendo suas necessidades, e por este motivo temos expressiva representação no mercado nacional e no mercado internacional, tendo o prestígio de ser referência nos mercados em que atua.

Responsabilidades

  1. Preparação da Máquina : Configurar e ajustar a calandra de acordo com as especificações do projeto, garantindo que as condições de operação sejam adequadas para o material a ser processado.
  2. Leitura de Desenhos Técnicos : Interpretar desenhos e especificações técnicas para entender as dimensões e formas necessárias para as peças a serem fabricadas.
  3. Seleção de Materiais : Escolher os tipos de chapas metálicas adequadas (como aço, alumínio, etc.) e verificar suas características, como espessura e resistência.
  4. Operação da Calandra : Conduzir o processo de calandragem, que envolve a passagem do material através de cilindros para moldá-lo nas formas desejadas (curvas, cilindros, etc.).
  5. Monitoramento do Processo : Observar continuamente o funcionamento da calandra, fazendo ajustes conforme necessário para garantir a qualidade do produto final e evitar defeitos.
  6. Controle de Qualidade : Inspecionar as peças produzidas para garantir que atendam às especificações de qualidade e medidas, realizando correções quando necessário.
  7. Registro de Produção : Manter registros de produção, como quantidades produzidas, tempo de operação e eventuais problemas enfrentados durante o processo.

Requisitos

  1. Formação Educacional : Ensino médio completo. Desejável cursos técnicos em áreas como mecânica, metalurgia ou processos industriais podem ser um diferencial.
  2. Experiência : Experiência prévia em operação de máquinas (Calandra). Conhecimento específico em calandragem ou em máquinas similares.
  3. Habilidades Técnicas : Conhecimento de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e esquemas. Familiaridade com o funcionamento e manutenção básica de calandras e outras máquinas de conformação de metal.
  4. Atenção aos Detalhes : Capacidade de identificar falhas e problemas durante o processo de produção.
  5. Habilidades : Habilidade para realizar cálculos básicos, como medições e conversões, é fundamental para garantir a precisão das peças produzidas.

Conhecimento básico sobre programação e operação de máquinas com controle numérico computadorizado (CNC), caso a calandra seja automatizada.

title: Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager
description:
NES Fircroft has a unique opportunity for a senior-level Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager, supporting the integration of a portfolio of high value projects into operations at a giant producing oilfield in Iraq.

The assignment is on a 12-month renewable contract, working on a 28/28 rotation.

Role synopsis

Our client is undertaking a large number of brownfield and greenfield projects in order to support and enhance production over the coming years.

This already complex field will increase in complexity requiring the incumbent to manage a challenging set of dynamic issues in the integration of the new projects into existing sites and the engagement of the site operations staff will be critical in ensuring the success of Rumaila for the coming years.

There is significant value at stake for this role to successfully manage a large project portfolio in one of the world’s largest oil fields, which comes with associated exposure to senior management.

The role ensures that the operational interfaces between operation and projects are effectively managed and with synergies maximised.

Accountable for driving continuous improvement across the projects start up & stay up.

The Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager functions under the Operations Organisation, reporting to the Senior Operations Manager.

The role includes significant people leadership and stakeholder management in an organisation of significant scale and complexity.

Key Accountabilities

  • Operations Readiness and Start-Up Manager is accountable to support projects and operations, acting as an interface in delivery of operations readiness for projects in service of safe, reliable and compliant start-up in the field.
  • Accountable for projects’ start-up in the field and pre-requisite activities to enable safe and efficient operations.
  • Understanding and experience in Operations Readiness & Assurance (OR&A) Delivery Requirements and project stage Gate readiness;
  • Proactive engagement with all operating departments to ensure the development will integrate into existing Brownfield Assets;
  • Promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  • Accountable to interface with Project Management team at earlier stage of the project to ensure provision of Operations and Commissioning inputs and planning are considered to deliver the project in accordance with the Scope of requirements (SOR).
  • Establish an O&M strategy for startup and earlier Operations phases and ensure strategy is reviewed and accepted by all project stakeholders.
  • Manage the delivery of all required operational support contracts (such as Chemicals / vendor support agreements) to support the Asset in the Operate phase.
  • Develop an Operations readiness plan (ORP) including the key readiness elements and O&M deliverables for the required project phases including commissioning and start up and earlier operations, ensure they are communicated in timely manner to project stakeholders,
  • Interface with the Contract and Finance departments for Contractor Performance and financial controls
  • Liaise closely with the Project Manager to manage the interfaces, ensure alignment, and Identify areas of improvement, best practices, and lessons learned from other similar projects and implement.
  • Manage & maintain focus on operability & maintainability issues throughout all aspects of the project design & execution planning.
  • Develop and monitor key performance Indicators to measure the effectiveness of the different phases of the O&M Scope.
  • Support the project assurance processes (such as Model Reviews / Hazop, Hazid, etc).
  • Manage the acceptance & handover from Project to Operations using the approved certification process (such Guidance OF Certification) ensuring a structured plan is developed in advance and implemented at the different project phases.
  • Ensure that Contractor documents (Plans, Manuals, procedures, and Method Statements) are reviewed and commented by Operations and readiness team members.
  • Ensure start up and ramp up plans are developed taking inputs from project stakeholders to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Contractor Commissioning and Start-up Team to ensure commissioning and start-up activities are planned and scheduled in line with the project standards and procedures. This includes establishing Flawless Start-up strategy and implementation of the program as per project.
  • Manage the HSSE performance of contractors during execution phases to ensure HSSE targets are met or exceeded – make HSSE a priority. Run contractor performance review on regular basis.

Criteria & Qualifications

  • BSc or BEng (UK), or international equivalent in an engineering discipline, or equivalent experience
  • Professional accreditation, such as Professional Engineer or Chartered Engineer
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in operations or engineering role, with at least 5 years in a management or senior leadership position, with significant experience leading Readiness delivery on major projects, with emphasis on Middle East and preferably in Iraq.
  • Good understanding of project management, commissioning and start-up procedures and hand over projects to Operations.
  • Business focused, able to priorities to maximize opportunities with no compromise on HSE.
  • Deep understanding of all aspects of delivering Operational Excellence in a large asset.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL
Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!
Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.
Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical
As a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs region.
The role entails

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects
What we are looking for in you
  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Estamos buscando um(a) Business Architect de Growth para atuar como ponte entre as áreas de marketing, produto, dados e tecnologia. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções que otimizem e acelerem as alavancas de crescimento, como CAC, LTV, conversão, recorrência, engajamento, expansão de canais e eficiência de aquisição.

Nossa História

A Insider nasceu para desafiar o status quo da indústria da moda. Desde 2017, aprendemos, inovamos e buscamos a excelência, criando um mundo onde todos são encorajados a subir a barra.

Hoje, temos mais de 800 mil clientes e um portfólio que combina tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade. Esta é apenas a nossa jornada de transformação na indústria da moda, uma das mais tradicionais e poluentes do mundo.

  • Collaborate with internal teams across region(s) to encourage ongoing thought leadership & MiQ product diversification
  • Attend all AM-related trainings and completion of Accreditation modules to ensure product knowledge remains current
  • Build rapport and foster positive collaboration with the Sales & Trading team on your commercial pod

Communication:

  • Collaborate with Senior Team Members across commercial business to provide support on key accounts
  • Strategize within AM department and the Commercial pod to grow and develop existing client business
  • Staying close with clients by reading related company news or industry trades, attend earnings calls to serve as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and clients

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of advertising technology and/or media planning experience
  • Experience with Programmatic Advertising is highly preferred; need for understanding of digital ecosystem and vendor-agency-advertiser dynamic
  • Commercial experience – clear evidence of servicing advertisers to a high standard and growing business from “one-time deals” to strategic partnerships measured through revenue and/or business line growth
  • A+ presentation skills with the ability to turn data points into a compelling media story.

Systems:

  • Experience with Google Campaign Manager, Sizmek MDX
  • Expertise with the Microsoft Office Suite
  • Salesforce, and Atlassian (JIRA) understanding preferred but not required ● Experience with Tag Managements systems is a plus!

Disposition:

  • Alignment with MiQ's core values
  • Competitive ‘winning’ mentality with a vision to grow your career as the company scales

What’s in it for you

MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to

make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.

Values:

Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do - no matter how big or small.

  • We do what we love - Passion
  • We figure it out - Determination
  • We anticipate the unexpected - Agility
  • We dare to be unconventional - Courage

Every region and office has specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:

  • A hybrid work environment
  • New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training ● Internal and global mobility opportunities
  • Bonus and performance incentives
  • Generous annual PTO, paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives
  • Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities

MiQ Pay Philosophy

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Brazil , MiQ is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Brazil and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At MiQ, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $260,000 - $289,000 BRL . This range may vary for positions outside of Brazil as it has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled and does not take into account our bonus and commission structures.

Regardless of location, candidates can expect during the first few conversations with MiQ’s Talent team and Hiring Managers to share any approved budget and details on our competitive bonus and commission packages. Please take a moment to view the MiQ I.D.E.A. Report to learn more about our approach to creating equitable compensation for our people.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)

title: Sesc abre inscrições de cursos gratuitos para educadores em Sobral
description:
Sesc abre inscrições de cursos gratuitos para educadores em Sobral

O Sesc Ceará abriu inscrições para novas turmas de cursos do programa Formação Contínua de Educadores, que este mês oferta oportunidades por meio das unidades dos municípios de Crato, Juazeiro do Norte, Iguatu, Fortaleza e Sobral. São 30 vagas por turma e as inscrições são gratuitas.

Em formatos on-line e presencial, as ações incluem cursos, oficinas e palestras, voltados a profissionais que atuam em atividades educacionais, como coordenadores, orientadores e professores.

Além dos educadores da Rede Sesc de Educação no Ceará, podem participar educadores das redes de ensino pública e particular, municipal e estadual. Os participantes recebem certificado de participação.

Temas dos Cursos

Neste mês, os cursos, palestras e oficinas abordam temas como Atendimento Educacional Especializado; Capacitismo na Educação; Chat GPT na Sala de Aula; A Contação de Histórias na Contramão da Aceleração Digital. Direcionadas para a Educação Infantil, há duas formações: Observação, Registro e Documentação; e Planejamento.

Programa Formação Contínua de Educadores

Com o programa, o Sesc busca “estabelecer vínculos entre a atualização constante dos professores e sua formação cultural, estimulando a integração de sua prática pedagógica com as diversas manifestações artísticas locais e ampliando suas possibilidades de acesso às produções culturais e científicas da sociedade”.

A proposta é desenvolvida por meio de cursos, oficinas, debates, palestras, seminários e Fórum de Educação. O público inclui estudantes de licenciaturas, professores, gestores e profissionais da educação.

Summary
Prepares and administers radioactive medication to patients for therapeutic or imaging purpose. Performs nuclear cardiac imaging for the cardiac patient population operating the nuclear camera. Provides technical support to medical professionals and Physicians for the diagnosis, treatment, and care of the cardiac patient population. On-call as required by the department.   • Performs high quality nuclear cardiology procedure for cardiac outpatients including explanation of test and safety precautions, operates equipment, provides assistance during testing, observes patient, and reports/follows-up on any abnormal activity and documents.

  • Prepares and administers the proper dosage of radiopharmaceuticals and isotopes to patients by either injection or inhalation.
  • Employs safety methods such as the use of syringe shields, gloves, and personal radiation-monitoring devices to protect patients and medical staff from radiation exposure.

  • Assists in quality assurance relating to calibration and maintenance of equipment, policies, and procedures and ICAL activity.
  • Performs required documentation and record keeping.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Nuclear Medicine
  • 1 year Experience as a nuclear medicine technologist in a hospital setting
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and to use discretion with confidential data that may impact staff and operation.
  • Ability to monitor/assess performance of oneself, others, or the organization to make improvements or take corrective action.
  • Demonstrates patient support activities such as patient flow, preparation, clean up, and turnaround of examination rooms.
  • Knowledge of nuclear medicine equipment and understanding of how to use it appropriately and safely to prevent radiation exposure as low as reasonably achievable.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • CNMT - Certified Nuclear Med Tech NMTCB - State of Pennsylvania or
  • RT - Registered Technologist Radiology - State of Pennsylvania
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree Nuclear Medicine
Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.

The team you will be a part of

The IT Sales, Marketing & Consumer Services team plays a strategic role in driving the digital transformation of our commercial and consumer-facing operations. The team is responsible for designing, delivering, and evolving technology solutions that support Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) and Business-to-Business (B2B) sales, digital marketing initiatives, and end-to-end consumer service operations. Acting as a key interface between business and IT, the team ensures that digital platforms, integration services, and core systems are aligned with business objectives, enabling seamless customer experiences and data-driven decision-making. Through strong partnerships with product, marketing, sales, and customer care teams, the group brings together business acumen and technical expertise to deliver impactful, scalable, and future-ready solutions.

This Role In Summary

As a Tech Manager, you will lead the technology strategy and execution across the consumer journey—from order placement to post-purchase—, ensuring seamless integration between e-commerce platforms, backend systems, and operational functions like order management, fulfillment, and customer care. You will co-manage internal products and integration services that connect D2C and B2B channels to ERP, logistics, and service platforms, driving scalability, transparency, and agility. Partnering with digital products, architecture, and business teams, you will lead agile squads to deliver high-quality, resilient, and maintainable solutions that support continuous improvement and future growth.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Lead technical software development teams in building and supporting scalable local and regional platforms and products that enable and accelerate D2C operations.
  • Propose, validate, and promote the adoption of the most effective technology stacks, development frameworks, and technical approaches in line with business and architectural goals.
  • Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements, acting as a key liaison between technology teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with product management and digital teams to co-create technology solutions with a clear purpose and compelling value propositions, ensuring strong alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Influence and manage stakeholder expectations across technical and business domains, effectively balancing priorities, communicating trade-offs, and fostering collaboration to drive outcomes.
  • Mediate conflicts and facilitate decision-making across teams and departments to maintain focus, clarity, and momentum.
  • Portfolio management, overseeing a diversity of projects, initiatives, and product backlogs, ensuring proper prioritization, resource alignment, and progress tracking.
  • Lead the delivery of highly complex projects and initiatives, ensuring adherence to cost, schedule, and scope while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
  • Collaborate with enterprise and solution architecture teams to ensure the implementation of future-proof solutions designed for long-term scalability, resilience, and adaptability.
  • Manage external vendors, contracts, and third-party development or integration teams, ensuring service quality, compliance, and alignment with internal standards and timelines.
  • Own key aspects of financial management for your area, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization, ensuring financial discipline while supporting business growth and innovation.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field;
  • Strong experience in technology leadership roles, with expertise in software development, large-scale projects, and mission-critical systems—preferably in e-commerce or D2C environments.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English;
  • Technical Skills:
    • Strong background in cloud-native development, microservices, APIs, and event-driven architectures.
    • Hands-on experience with integration platforms and backend systems (ERP, OMS, CRM).
    • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
    • Proficiency in JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, and Python.
  • E-commerce: Proven track record in delivering consumer-facing digital platforms in collaboration with product and UX teams.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management:
    • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, expectation management, and business alignment.
    • Experience managing third-party vendors, contracts, and SLAs.
  • Financial Acumen: Budgeting, forecasting, and cost management experience within a tech environment.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing agile teams with a focus on business value and continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills And Experiences

  • Previous experience with ERP systems and integrations (mainly SAP).
  • Previous experience with VTEX platform.
  • Cloud/AWS certifications.
  • Fluency in the Digital Product Management space.
  • Spanish (intermediate).
  • Master’s degree or MBA.

What We Offer

  • One day of home office per week;
  • Flexible schedule
  • "No dress code".
  • Gympass;
  • Transportation voucher, Shuttle buses or Free parking at the company;
  • Food voucher;
  • Meal on site;
  • Benefits such as payment-deducted or social loans, health plan, dental plan, life insurance, and private pension plan compatible with the market;
  • Employee Support Program, with 24-hour assistance from legal, social, financial, social workers, and psychologists;
  • Daycare assistance or Nursery at the company;
  • Services available on-site: beauty and aesthetics salon, internal bank agency, laundry, cafeteria, restaurant, and lactation room;
  • Two weeks of remote work from anywhere;
  • After 5 years with the company, eligible employees can take four weeks of paid leave;
  • Discount on products through Compra Certa.
  • Discount on insurance (pet, auto, home, bike, travel, and more)
  • Extended maternity/paternity leave

Additional Information

This position is located in São Paulo, Brazil, about 15 minutes away from Sacomã Metro station on the Green Line. Here is where our Spare Parts Distribution Center and the Administrative Headquarters of the following departments are concentrated: Compra Certa (e-commerce), Technology, Customer Service, Logistics, Controllership, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Human Resources, Communication, Supplies, and Digital.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Como Product Manager com foco na visão Cayman, você será responsável por liderar projetos estratégicos que envolvem a digitalização e otimização dos fluxos operacionais do Private Wealth Management (PWM), com ênfase nas operações e integrações relacionadas à estrutura offshore em Cayman. Seu papel será essencial para identificar novas oportunidades de evolução na experiência do cliente PWM, garantir a conformidade e eficiência dos processos, além de colaborar na construção de plano de negócio para o comitê executivo (TAC e NAC) em parceria com áreas sponsors para viabilizar novas linhas de negócio utilizando a estrutura de Cayman.

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia n o Instagram e no LinkedIn .

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor .

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em digitalização e otimização de processos no segmento de Private Wealth Management, com forte conhecimento das operações offshore, especialmente em Cayman.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de digitalização, como workflow, OCR, inteligência artificial generativa (Gen AI) e RPA.
  • Experiência em discovery de produtos e processos, com foco na melhoria da experiência do cliente PWM e integração offshore.
  • Habilidade para construir e negociar TACs e NACs em conjunto com áreas sponsors e stakeholders, considerando aspectos regulatórios e operacionais de Cayman.
  • Perfil de liderança, com capacidade para gerenciar equipes multifuncionais e projetos complexos em ambientes regulados.
  • Proatividade, organização e habilidade para priorizar tarefas em ambientes dinâmicos e multiculturais.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, com capacidade para atuar em interface com áreas internas, externas e reguladores.
Desafios e Impacto
  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar processos operacionais do PWM relacionados a negociações de notas, certificados de depósito (CDs) e crédito, com foco na integração e conformidade das operações em Cayman.
  • Realizar discovery de novas frentes de evolução na experiência do cliente PWM, especialmente na interface e integração com as operações offshore em Cayman.
  • Colaborar com áreas sponsors para a construção e formalização de TACs e NACs, garantindo que novas linhas de negócio estejam alinhadas com as regulamentações e estruturas de Cayman.
  • Definir e priorizar o backlog das squads responsáveis pela digitalização e evolução dos processos PWM com visão offshore, assegurando alinhamento com as necessidades estratégicas do negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes técnicas e de compliance para garantir a entrega de soluções eficazes, inovadoras e em conformidade com as exigências regulatórias de Cayman.
  • Monitorar e reportar o progresso dos projetos, garantindo o cumprimento dos objetivos, prazos e padrões de qualidade.
Etapas do Processo

  • Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  • Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  • Vídeo entrevista : Uma oportunidade para nos conhecermos melhor e entender suas motivações e experiências.

  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  • Avaliação técnica : Focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

  • Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Entrevista com colegas de trabalho : Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.

  • Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  • Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

    • Benefícios que oferecemos:

    Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.
